note: Commit d4bfe91a6 adds one clause to the phraseme route guide (breakdown-routes, phraseme parts only): the infinitive after the PART zu is a VERB, and an infinitive is a NOUN only when used as one, capitalised or after an article. Before it, mit zu tun haben linked tun to the NOUN Tun every repetition (NOUN 0.51-0.56 against VERB 0.42-0.48) and zu to the ADP in repetition 0 (0.51 against PART 0.47): the shared NOUN description counts substantivized infinitives, and a noun after zu reads as a preposition's object. The shared route descriptions stay as they are, since segment.inUnits asks them too. Word cases, real text and adversarial ask nothing new. Strict is contractPass, 3 repetitions.
